name: iMessage
note: Blue bubbles, via Messages for Business or bridges
summary: Apple has no public iMessage bot API. Businesses use Apple Messages for Business through an Apple-approved Messaging Service Provider and pass an Experience Review before going live. Individuals and startups instead use Mac-based bridges such as the open-source BlueBubbles server, or commercial iMessage API providers such as Sendblue.
facts: No public bot API; Messages for Business via approved MSPs
Apple Business Register account and Experience Review
First automated reply within 5 s, labelled as automated, live-agent escape
BlueBubbles server (Apache-2.0, runs on a Mac)
Sendblue: free sandbox, $100/month per AI agent line
goodFor: Reaching iPhone users in the native Messages app
Brand customer service with Apple Pay and pickers
watchOut: Business route requires an approved provider and review
Bridges depend on a Mac and unofficial access
No Android reach without SMS or RCS fallback
